scope: Independent correctness validation; not an official hidden-set score
method: Four independent mutations of the pinned baseline, excluding sample-edited locations. All selections frozen before mutant execution. For every mutation, execute every test selected by the previous precision logic plus a fixed unrelated 19-test subset.
real_process_execution: Native ProcessPoolExecutor retained. Offline validation initially used a 2-core quota, increased to 4 cores; later children capped process pools at 2 workers. Contest selector benchmarks use separate unchanged 2-core limits.
limitations: The fixed suite and generated mutations do not prove safety for arbitrary hidden changes. Raw mutant-to-failure observations remain outside the submission repository.
